history.alt_text: An illuminated house with a sleek wall-mounted home battery stands out against a dark, blacked-out neighborhood at night.
history.caption: Home battery fleets delivered record grid support before the state's aggregator funding season abruptly ended.
history.title: Home Battery Grid Record

style_when: the story is about change after hours — automation displacing shifts, a market open all night, capacity running while people sleep
prompt: 35mm anamorphic wide architectural photograph at blue hour. Asymmetric off-centre composition with heavy editorial negative space on the left. A modern suburban house stands out on a completely dark residential street, its glass windows glowing with warm amber light during a neighborhood power outage. On the exterior textured stucco wall, a sleek, brushed-metal home battery unit emits a soft LED status ring. Deep blue ambient light, crisp atmospheric depth, restrained teal-and-amber palette, long-exposure calm with no moving figures. High-contrast, premium editorial cover standard.
negative_prompt: text, typography, watermark, garbled letters, logos, labels
rationale: The architectural_night treatment perfectly captures the reality of home batteries discharging during a grid event or outage. Showing one illuminated home against a dark neighborhood visually represents the capacity contribution while people sleep.
subject: an illuminated suburban house with a glowing wall-mounted home battery during a neighborhood blackout
core_thesis: California home batteries delivered a record 745 MW to the grid, but the state program paying for this capacity ends on October 31 with no future funding secured.
core_conflict: Record physical hardware performance versus an abrupt financial funding cliff
composition: asymmetric off-centre composition with heavy negative space
alt_text: The 745 MW Battery Cliff. An illuminated house with a sleek wall-mounted home battery stands out against a dark, blacked-out neighborhood.
caption: The 745 MW Battery Cliff: Record home battery pools face a state funding cliff.
title: The 745 MW Battery Cliff
